candidate.name: single_packed_cpu_full_mask_staging
candidate.causal_hypothesis: The depth-12 mask expansion is launch-latency and submission dominated: the current Python loop creates multiple tiny eager CUDA operations and one H2D per live row outside the captured model graph. Packing the identical ragged bool layout into one pinned CPU buffer and issuing one H2D removes the row-wise GPU fanout without changing attention math.
source_complete_change: In NGRAMWorker._init_preallocated_tensors add geometrically growable pinned-CPU bool and CUDA-bool full-mask staging buffers owned by the worker.
Add NGRAMWorker._ensure_full_mask_capacity(required_numel), growing both buffers only when the high-water mark increases and retaining the old CUDA buffer until its forward stream is safe.
Add NGRAMWorker._pack_full_mask_cpu(mask, seq_lens_cpu): for row i and query q, write True for seq_lens_cpu[i] prefix positions followed by mask[i,q,:] in the exact existing ragged row-major order.

Replace only the USE_FULL_MASK per-request torch.ones/from_numpy/to/cat/to(bool) loop and final torch.cat with one CPU pack into the pinned slice and one non_blocking CUDA copy into the staging slice.

Keep reconstruct_indices_from_tree_mask, draft-token transfer, assign_extend_cache_locs_func, NgramVerifyInput fields, graph padding, HybridAttnBackend selection, Triton metadata, graph replay, sampling, KV move, result copy and scheduler settlement unchanged.
Expose exactly the live-mask-length device slice as NgramVerifyInput.custom_mask; the existing graph buffer fill and all-True padded-row behavior remain unchanged.
